title: Negative gas adsorption transitions and pressure amplification phenomena in porous frameworks
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00555D, Review Article

Simon Krause, Jack D. Evans, Volodymyr Bon, Irena Senkovska, François-Xavier Coudert, Gulliaume Maurin, Eike Brunner, Philip L. Llewellyn, Stefan Kaskel
The discovery of Negative Gas Adsorption (NGA), its experimental characterization, and the toolbox for systematic understanding are reviewed, along with an outlook on future applications and materials discovery pathways.
